## RunEnv.cache property

the per-key store every run shares. Default: none: every run reads its sources. A runner then  keeps the scopes of the gates its runs stop at, for an hour, so that an approval covers a part  of its keys on resume; `run` keeps nothing, and an approval covers its own gate id only

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly cache?: CachePort;
```
